_comment: The single docs-owned declaration of the current product release, plus the two
reviewable lists that scripts/check-versions.py enforces. Every release pass
updates current_release and re-reads current_transcripts; see README.md, 'Release
pass'. No script in this repo judges whether a sentence is 'qualified enough' or
whether a version has a 'good reason' — those judgements live here, in a file a
_not_a_product_version: A captured transcript also prints the environment it ran in. A semver is not the
product version when the text immediately before it on the line matches one of
these: a python label (python 3.13.13, "python": "3.13.13") or a hyphen, which is
_current_transcripts: Files that must carry at least one captured transcript stating current_release,
inside a fenced code block. A release pass that forgets to recapture one fails here.
_version_allowlist: Every product-version occurrence in prose (outside fenced code blocks). Anything
not listed here fails. tracks_current: true means the value must equal
current_release, so a release pass cannot leave it behind.

version_allowlist.reason: Provenance sentence for the captured transcripts on this page.
Release history: 0.6.1 split reachability from sources_not_built, and added that key. Two occurrences, both about that change.
Release history: the doctor --json interface became stable at 0.5.2.
Release history: 0.5.0 and 0.5.1 emitted the undocumented duplicate ok / tool_version keys.
Release history: the shortlist tie-break correctness fix landed in 0.6.0.
Release history: eval results have been keyed by profile from v0.2.1 onward.

_pinned_links: Links that must stay pinned to an exact commit because they are evidence, not

pinned_links.reason: Measurement provenance: the record as it stood at the released commit.

_replay_paragraph: Wherever any of these figures appears, the complete paragraph must appear
verbatim. Publishing a fragment is what turns a one-stage replay into an
replay_paragraph: In controlled replay, stateless parallel screening reduced the screening stage from 979 seconds to 73 seconds and from $3.00 to $0.76. The implementation remains experimental while end-to-end golden non-inferiority is validated.
_timing_figures: Measured wall-clock and cost figures live on the Measurements page only.
Captured transcripts are exempt: a fenced block is recorded output, not a claim.
_pubmed: The known misleading phrasing, and the statement that must be present instead.
Exact substrings, so the check has no opinion about wording beyond these.
